description: Wake a hibernating server so it comes back online. Lite servers hibernate when nobody is playing and have to be woken before anyone can connect. A user reporting they "can't join" or that their server "is asleep" usually needs this. Waking takes a minute or two; poll get_instance_info for the status afterwards.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: wake_instance
title: Wake Hibernating Instance
